title: Idle Controller Actions
statement: For Boolean finite Turing machines $B$ and $F$, every input-head direction and every optional loop-host successor state determine a controller action with no flag, counter, or payload write or movement and no output. This action equals the input-only action with that direction and successor state, which leaves every work tape and work head unchanged.
replaced:
For every input direction and successor state, the loop-controller action that performs
no flag, counter, or payload operation and emits nothing equals the standard input-only
control action with that direction and successor.
